title: NWSL Soccer
description:
Gotham FC at Denver Summit
Denver Summit FC hosts NWSL leaders Gotham FC at Centennial Stadium in Centennial, Colorado, for matchday 23. Ninth-placed Denver hosts Gotham on matchday 23 of 30 in the NWSL. Gotham has a three-match win streak, while Denver won 6-1 last time out.

title: NWSL Soccer
description:
Washington Spirit at Portland Thorns FC
Portland Thorns FC hosts Washington Spirit in NWSL matchday 23 at Providence Park. Washington Spirit has won just one of its last four league matches, while Portland has won three of its last four matches prior to a draw during last weekend.
